name: Waitly
summary: Free open-source Next.js waitlist page template with an email capture form, dark mode and shadcn/ui components.
description: A free single-page waitlist template for products before launch: headline and pitch, an email signup form that shows a confirmation toast (UI only — connect your own service), and social links. Built with Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, with light and dark styles.
contains: single waitlist page: headline, email signup form, social links
Next.js 16 App Router with shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS
light and dark theme; deploys to Vercel
